messages:
Emma (product): Need a compact GA decision checklist covering SLA, docs, support routing, monitoring, and pricing. Want a one-pager PM can use to flip to GA. Volunteers?

Dan (eng-runtime): I can own runtime/SLA knobs. Proposal: two SLA tiers with p95 targets (standard=300ms, priority=150ms) and an automatic fallback list for model variants. Need Console visibility for knobs before GA.

Priya (devex): Ill take docs & quickstart. Will include migration notes for quantized variants and a short FAQ entry about fallbacks. Recommend a pinned one-page runbook in the launch channel.

Omar (sre): Monitoring owner. Minimum: p95/p99 traces, per-route error-rate, and alert: error rate > 2.5% for 5m -> P1. Need OpsPager rota for first 30 days. Also want a rollback play that cuts traffic to 10% on P1.

Lea (finance): I'll draft pricing table: pilot-band (discounted, 30d) + GA published rates. Need unit examples for token generative vs embedding calls and a pilot credit policy.

LegalBot: Please attach SLA draft for review. Note: call out quantization as a non-guaranteed compatibility item in the SLA annex.

Emma (product): Decision vector to require: (1) docs + quickstart, (2) monitoring + alerts live, (3) legal SLA signoff, (4) pricing published (pilot noted), (5) 48h clean canary. If any missing -> hold.

Dan (eng-runtime): For canary, enable `fallback_model` and set `max_batch_latency_ms=25`. We'll expose these as Console toggles.

Priya (devex): Action: draft one-page runbook + FAQ (24h) and create `#ga-minimum-launch` channel and pin artifacts (today).

Omar (sre): Action: dashboards & alert rules (48h), OpsPager rota (48h), rollback automation stub (72h).

Lea (finance): Action: pricing table + pilot credit terms + billing hold spec (48h).

Emma (product): PM checkpoint: canary start 2025-09-10T16:00Z, decision 2025-09-12T12:00Z. If no P1s in 48h and all items green -> proceed to staged GA.

Priya (devex): Will post runbook here when ready.

Dan (eng-runtime): 👍

Omar (sre): 👍

Lea (finance): 👍

Emma (product): Thanks team. I'll close thread after checkpoint and publish GA flip note if approved.
